---
title: "Stacking, labels and features"
bread-crumbs: false
---

A style is a stack of layers: background, water, roads, labels and so on.
basemapper can draw only some of them, and can stack several styles into
one map.

::: {#9fc99dc7 .cell execution_count=1}
``` {.python .cell-code}
import basemapper as bm

slc = (-111.8887, 40.7556)
def view(style, **kw):
    return bm.basemap(style, 720, 405, center=slc, zoom=12.4, **kw)
```
:::


## What a style draws

`list_layers()` lists a style's layers in drawing order, with the vector
tile layer each one draws (`source_layer`) and the *feature* it shows:

::: {#c261db21 .cell execution_count=2}
``` {.python .cell-code}
from collections import Counter

layers = bm.list_layers("OpenFreeMap.Liberty")
print(len(layers), "layers")
for l in layers[:10]:
    print(f"{l['id']:<22} {l['type']:<10} {str(l['source_layer']):<14} {l['feature']}")
print(Counter(l["feature"] for l in layers))
```

::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout}
```
111 layers
background             background None           background
natural_earth          raster     None           terrain
park                   fill       park           parks
park_outline           line       park           parks
landuse_residential    fill       landuse        landcover
landcover_wood         fill       landcover      landcover
landcover_grass        fill       landcover      landcover
landcover_ice          fill       landcover      landcover
landcover_wetland      fill       landcover      landcover
landuse_pitch          fill       landuse        landcover
Counter({'roads': 58, 'rail': 12, 'landcover': 11, 'places': 9, 'water': 7, 'poi': 5, 'boundaries': 3, 'parks': 2, 'buildings': 2, 'background': 1, 'terrain': 1})
```
:::
:::


## Labels

`labels=False` draws a style without its labels (text and icons):

::: {#64738e3a .cell execution_count=3}
``` {.python .cell-code}
view("OpenFreeMap.Liberty", labels=False)
```

::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=3}
![](layers_files/figure-html/cell-4-output-1.png){width=720 height=405}
:::
:::


`labels="only"` draws just the labels, on a transparent background, to go
over another map.

## Stacking

A list of styles is drawn bottom to top. To filter one style of a stack,
give the filter to `basemap_provider()`; this puts satellite imagery under a
vector basemap's labels:

::: {#fab74848 .cell execution_count=4}
``` {.python .cell-code}
hybrid = ["Esri.WorldImagery", bm.basemap_provider("OpenFreeMap.Liberty", labels="only")]
view(hybrid)
```

::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=4}
![](layers_files/figure-html/cell-5-output-1.png){width=720 height=405}
:::
:::


ArcGIS basemaps are often published as separate services, drawn in order.
The Utah Geospatial Resource Center's *Lite* basemap is a hillshade, a base
map and labels:

::: {#4f1c3f4b .cell execution_count=5}
``` {.python .cell-code}
ugrc = "https://tiles.arcgis.com/tiles/99lidPhWCzftIe9K/arcgis/rest/services"
lite = [f"{ugrc}/{s}/VectorTileServer/resources/styles/root.json"
        for s in ["VectorHillshade", "LiteBase", "LiteLabels"]]
bm.basemap(lite, 720, 405, center=(-111.75, 40.62), zoom=10.5)
```

::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=5}
![](layers_files/figure-html/cell-6-output-1.png){width=720 height=405}
:::
:::


## Features

`features` keeps or drops parts of the map by what they show: background,
water, landcover, parks, buildings, roads, rail, boundaries, places, poi and
terrain. Plain names keep, `"-name"` drops.

::: {#d9e83480 .cell execution_count=6}
``` {.python .cell-code}
view("OpenFreeMap.Liberty", labels=False, features=["background", "water", "parks", "roads"])
```

::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=6}
![](layers_files/figure-html/cell-7-output-1.png){width=720 height=405}
:::
:::


::: {#22579593 .cell execution_count=7}
``` {.python .cell-code}
view("OpenFreeMap.Liberty", features=["-roads", "-rail", "-poi"])
```

::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=7}
![](layers_files/figure-html/cell-8-output-1.png){width=720 height=405}
:::
:::


`list_layers()` takes the same filters and lists what a render with them
draws, to check a filter before rendering:

::: {#533c60b8 .cell execution_count=8}
``` {.python .cell-code}
for l in bm.list_layers("OpenFreeMap.Liberty", labels=False, features=["water", "parks"]):
    print(f"{l['id']:<22} {l['type']:<6} {l['feature']}")
```

::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout}
```
park                   fill   parks
park_outline           line   parks
waterway_tunnel        line   water
waterway_river         line   water
waterway_other         line   water
water                  fill   water
```
:::
:::


## Layers

Features are sorted from each layer's source layer, as a convenience. For
exact control, `layers` keeps layers by id, or drops them with `"-"`; `*`
and `?` are wildcards:

::: {#60a53142 .cell execution_count=9}
``` {.python .cell-code}
view("OpenFreeMap.Liberty", layers=["-road_*", "-bridge_*", "-tunnel_*"])
```

::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=9}
![](layers_files/figure-html/cell-10-output-1.png){width=720 height=405}
:::
:::


A name that matches no layer warns, so a typo does not go unnoticed:

::: {#8c4dd703 .cell execution_count=10}
``` {.python .cell-code}
m = view("OpenFreeMap.Liberty", layers=["-lable_village"])
_ = m.render_array()
```

::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stderr}
```
D:\GitHub\basemapper\py-basemapper\src\basemapper\_basemap.py:200: UserWarning: layers: "-lable_village" matches no layer
```
:::
:::


## In plots

The plot layers take the same arguments:

::: {#ac0d3caa .cell execution_count=11}
``` {.python .cell-code}
import geodatasets
import geopandas as gpd
from plotnine import geom_map, ggplot, theme, theme_void

nc = gpd.read_file(geodatasets.get_path("geoda.sids"))
water = bm.basemap_provider("OpenFreeMap.Liberty", features=["water"], labels=False)

(
    ggplot(nc)
    + bm.geom_basemap(["Esri.WorldShadedRelief", water])
    + geom_map(fill=None, color="#262626", size=0.25)
    + theme_void()
    + theme(figure_size=(8, 3.6))
)
```

::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=11}
